//: The one fictional client every self-rendered lens example is built from, so the images teach the direction rather than a brand. Tune freely; keep it neutral enough to be styled every way from Corporate Confident to Brutalist.
what: A marketing website for Fieldnote, a small independent architecture and interiors studio of six people in Portland, Oregon. They design homes, small hospitality spaces and workplace interiors, and they want the site to bring in the right kind of client: people who value considered, durable work over trends.
audience: homeowners planning a significant renovation or new build
owners of cafés, restaurants and small hotels
founders fitting out a first office
notes: Real photography of built work: interiors, materials, light. No stock people.
